# FG-LLM-0003

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 503 |
| 重大度 | alert |
| Runbook | [`llm-model-update`](../../ops/runbooks/llm-model-update.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `model_digest_mismatch_stops_gateway` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: AI のモデルが決められたものと違うため、AI の助言を止めています。管理者が確認します。
- en: The AI advice is stopped because the AI model is not the pinned one. An administrator will check it.
- id: Saran AI dihentikan karena model AI bukan model yang ditetapkan. Administrator akan memeriksanya.

## 原因 (cause)

Plan 19 §8.1, plan 17 §6 (ADR-0039): the model Ollama serves under `llm.model`'s `name:tag` has a digest other than the pinned `sha256:…` (someone pulled a new version, or the shared Ollama was updated for Kanflow), or the model is not there (`reason=model_missing`). The gateway stops all inference until the digest matches again: waiting requests are failed with this code (`reason=stopped`, recorded `abandoned`), new ones are refused. A model must never change silently — its advice would no longer be the evaluated one.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The worker logs it once per streak with `task=llm_model_check`, `model`, `expected_digest` and `actual_digest` (or `reason=model_missing`); later requests carry `reason=stopped`. Check (read-only): `curl -s <llm.endpoint>/api/tags` and compare the model's `digest` with `llm.model` in the configuration; ask the Kanflow side whether they changed the model.

## 対処 (fix)

Runbook llm-model-update: either put the pinned model back on Ollama (`ollama pull name:tag` of the evaluated version, agreed with Kanflow), or change `llm.model` to the new digest in a reviewed MR after the eval set passed with it. The gateway checks again every 10 minutes and resumes on its own when the digests match.
